requirements.text: During the immunity test, the rear lamp under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: Measurements on the rear lamp shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer. Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: When tested for immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the rear lamp as well as to other connections of the rear lamp which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: When tested for immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines of the rear lamp as well as to other connections of the rear lamp which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the rear lamp on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines as well as on other connections of the rear lamp which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (a) A rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (b) A rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2 emitting more than the maximum value of category RM1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (c) A stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (d) A stop lamp category S4 emitting more than the maximum value of category S3;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (e) A direction indicator of category 2b emitting more than the maximum value of category 2a;

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.quote: (f) A rear fog lamp of category F2 emitting more than the maximum value of category F1. Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.

requirements.text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the retro-reflective device.
requirements.quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.

requirements.text: If any mirror effect is produced when the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.quote: If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: In case the lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.

requirements.text: If a tell-tale indicating failure is required by the component regulation, the stop lamp shall have a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;

requirements.text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.quote: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

requirements.text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection RA after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the retro-reflective device shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.

requirements.text: The RI shall be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face of the retro-reflective device has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

requirements.text: The approval marking of the lamp shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: After the rear face of the retro-reflective device has been brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the rear face of the retro-reflective device for one minute.
requirements.quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.

requirements.text: After the cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 has been applied to the rear face for one minute, the cotton cloth shall be removed and the retro-reflective device shall be left to dry.
requirements.quote: The cotton cloth is then removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamp shall be operated, unless tested as in paragraph 4.8.2.3.2., at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.
requirements.quote: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources: 4.8.2.3.1. shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources operated in accordance with paragraph 4.8.2.3.1., the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
requirements.quote: The measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.

requirements.text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the lamp may alternatively be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.
requirements.quote: 4.8.2.3.2. alternatively, may be tested by using one light source in each of the individual lamp holder positions operating at the reference/objective luminous flux and application of the sum of the measured luminous intensities for each direction.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.quote: Additionally, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.

requirements.text: The position of the rear lamp, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width.
requirements.quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.

requirements.text: The position of the rear lamp, as regards width, shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
requirements.quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, the single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the single approval mark is visible after their installation.
requirements.quote: It is visible after their installation.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the rear lamp shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: Where the applicant requests that the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of the rear lamp incorporate a manufacturer logo, the rear lamp shall incorporate only one manufacturer logo built by transparent or non-transparent components, provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and in addition the following conditions:

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be allowed.
requirements.quote: (a) Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the applicant shall confirm the logo by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).
requirements.quote: This shall be confirmed by the applicant by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of the lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.quote: (b) Size: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: The stop lamp and the reversing lamp shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.quote: (d) Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" is defined in Table 1.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.
requirements.quote: Moreover, the electrical connections of the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be such that these devices cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are switched ON.

requirements.text: When the devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion of the vehicle up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, the devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control.
requirements.quote: (a) The devices shall be switched ON and OFF manually by a separate control;

requirements.text: If the devices fitted on the side of the vehicle are switched ON for slow manoeuvres in forward motion up to a maximum speed of 15 km/h, they may remain ON after reverse gear is disengaged.
requirements.quote: (b) If so switched ON, they may remain ON after reverse gear is disengaged;

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) that complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used for the narrowband emission measurement.
requirements.quote: Alternative measuring location As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).

requirements.text: In the dust exposure test, the test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.quote: The dust The test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.*

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflector shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
requirements.quote: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.

requirements.text: Outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, the measurement of the light emitted towards the rear of the vehicle shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical transversal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The measurement shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical transversal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, when the apparent surfaces of the reversing projector and of the reversing lamp are arranged in such a way that the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, the reversing projector shall be tested together with the reversing lamp.
requirements.quote: (b) When the apparent surfaces of the reversing projector and the apparent surface of the reversing lamp are arranged in such a way that: (i) Either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis; or

requirements.text: Outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, when the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, the reversing projector shall be tested together with the reversing lamp.
requirements.quote: (ii) The minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of them does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, the reversing projector shall be tested together with the reversing lamp and the integrated luminous intensity shall not exceed the maximum luminous intensity required in the Table 10.

requirements.text: For direction-indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, instead of the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.2. and in addition to the requirements of paragraph 4.6.1.1., a signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option a), b) or c) (notwithstanding the provisions stated in paragraph 4.6.).
requirements.quote: A signal for activation of the tell-tale prescribed in paragraph 6.5.8. of Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 6.3.8. of Regulation No. 53 shall be produced on the basis of either option a), b) or c) (notwithstanding the provisions stated in paragraph 4.6.):

requirements.text: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The following equipment shall be used to test for dust exposure:.
requirements.quote: The following equipment shall be used to test for dust exposure:

requirements.text: When the rear direction indicator lamp of category 2b, the rear position lamp of category R2 or the stop lamp of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control is in transition between intensities, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.

requirements.text: Compliance of the retro-reflective device of Class IVA with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
requirements.quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1 above), the inward horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: However, for the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: To be considered visible, the direction-indicator lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, except for side direction-indicators of categories 5 and 6.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the apparent surface of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
requirements.quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.

requirements.text: When assessing light which could give rise to confusion, no account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.
requirements.quote: No account shall be taken of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.

requirements.text: The applicable change indexes for each device relating to the series of amendments shall be as given in Table 2 (see also paragraph 6.1.1.).
requirements.quote: The applicable change indexes for each device relating to the series of amendments shall be as follows (see also paragraph 6.1.1.): Table 2 Series of amendments and change index

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 4.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 4.

requirements.text: The method of measurement shall be defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service.
requirements.quote: The method of measurement shall be defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service.

requirements.text: Vehicles which do not have electrical/electronic systems with "immunity related functions" need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.4. and with Annex 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Vehicles which do not have electrical/electronic systems with "immunity related functions" need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.4. and with Annex 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the rear lamp's intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
requirements.quote: The intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.

requirements.text: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values of broadband electromagnetic radiation, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the vehicle representative of its type shall be tested by the method described in Annex 6.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements of the rear lamp, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the narrowband limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the narrowband limits shall be 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the narrowband limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the narrowband limits shall be 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 5 using a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, the apparent surfaces of the stop lamp and direction-indicator lamp in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
requirements.quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, measurements shall be carried out in such a way as to meet the following requirements:.
requirements.quote: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, measurements shall be carried out in such a way as to meet the following requirements:

requirements.text: Other vehicle systems, which can affect immunity related functions, shall be tested in a way to be agreed between manufacturer and Technical Service.
requirements.quote: Other vehicle systems, which can affect immunity related functions, shall be tested in a way to be agreed between manufacturer and Technical Service.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is equipped with a cruise control system, it shall be used to maintain the required constant vehicle speed and maintained without any deactivation.
requirements.quote: If the vehicle is equipped with a cruise control system, it shall be used to maintain the required constant vehicle speed and maintained without any deactivation.

requirements.text: The basic vehicle conditions shall be change of gear ratio inducing a speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed. (in case of automatic gearbox).
requirements.quote: In case of automatic gearbox: change of gear ratio inducing a speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed.
