requirements.text: AECS vehicle test conditions before and after immunity test Failure criteria A manual emergency call shall be triggered according to the vehicle manufacturer’s instructions, both before and after conducting the 50km/h or brake mode test.
requirements.quote: AECS vehicle test conditions before and after immunity test Failure criteria A manual emergency call shall be triggered according to the vehicle manufacturer’s instructions, both before and after conducting the 50km/h or brake mode test.

requirements.text: Once the MSD has been received the emergency call is established, voice communication shall be evaluated, but only if voice communications are available in the AECS system.
requirements.quote: Once the MSD has been received the emergency call is established, voice communication shall be evaluated, but only if voice communications are available in the AECS system.

requirements.text: After the evaluation of the voice call, the emergency call shall be terminated.
requirements.quote: After the evaluation of the voice call, the emergency call shall be terminated.

requirements.text: Subsequently, the transmitted Minimum Set of Data (MSD) shall be evaluated.
requirements.quote: Subsequently, the transmitted Minimum Set of Data (MSD) shall be evaluated.

requirements.text: AECSs vehicle test conditions during immunity test Failure criteria During the 50km/h or brake test mode, the warning signal device (also known as the tell-tale, which provides a failure indication), and all other displays used for indicating AECS faults, shall be monitored.
requirements.quote: AECSs vehicle test conditions during immunity test Failure criteria During the 50km/h or brake test mode, the warning signal device (also known as the tell-tale, which provides a failure indication), and all other displays used for indicating AECS faults, shall be monitored.

requirements.text: AVAS test conditions Failure criteria Vehicle is tested in an operating state where the AVAS Function/sound is active (if applicable) (1) Loss of AVAS function (loss of sound or system error indicator) AVAS test conditions Failure criteria (1) This test may be incorporated into Brake or 50 km/h mode if AVAS system is active in these modes.
requirements.quote: AVAS test conditions Failure criteria Vehicle is tested in an operating state where the AVAS Function/sound is active (if applicable) (1) Loss of AVAS function (loss of sound or system error indicator) AVAS test conditions Failure criteria (1) This test may be incorporated into Brake or 50 km/h mode if AVAS system is active in these modes.

requirements.text: If AVAS system is not operational during these two modes, the operating conditions (e.g. vehicle speed) shall be agreed between the Technical Service and the Vehicle Manufacturer.
requirements.quote: If AVAS system is not operational during these two modes, the operating conditions (e.g. vehicle speed) shall be agreed between the Technical Service and the Vehicle Manufacturer.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation, and the compliance with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5. shall be verified in that the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 are complied with.
requirements.quote: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 shall be complied with;

requirements.text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
requirements.quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.

requirements.text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, the ESA shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.quote: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.

requirements.text: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.
requirements.quote: If provided, the reversing projections shall be switched ON only when the reversing lamp(s) is/are switched ON.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be in a number such that the requirements for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.quote: Number Such that the requirements for longitudinal positioning are complied with.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.17.4. below) may be installed only if they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.17.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so manufactured that no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values of the lamps shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.quote: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12:

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 5.

requirements.text: For the purposes of determining the lower, upper and lateral edges of the device, only horizontal and vertical planes shall be considered.
requirements.quote: For the purposes of determining the lower, upper and lateral edges of the device, only horizontal and vertical planes shall be considered.

requirements.text: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values of the rear lamp narrowband electromagnetic radiation, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limit.
requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limit.

requirements.text: Where approval of the vehicle type is obtained by testing of individual ESAs, the rear lamp electrical/electronic systems or ESAs shall have been approved in accordance with this Regulation and shall be installed in accordance with any conditions attached thereto.
requirements.quote: A vehicle manufacturer may obtain approval for the vehicle by demonstrating to the Type Approval Authority that all the relevant (see paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation) electrical/electronic systems or ESAs have been approved in accordance with this Regulation and have been installed in accordance with any conditions attached thereto.

requirements.text: The conformity of production procedures for the rear lamp shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).
requirements.quote: The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the following requirements:

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comply with the chromaticity coordinates.
requirements.quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.

requirements.text: To determine the lower, upper and lateral limits of the illuminating surface of the rear lamp, only screens with horizontal or vertical edges shall be used to verify the distance to the extreme edges of the vehicle and the height above the ground.
requirements.quote: To determine the lower, upper and lateral limits of the illuminating surface only screens with horizontal or vertical edges shall be used to verify the distance to the extreme edges of the vehicle and the height above the ground.

requirements.text: For other applications of the illuminating surface, e.g. distance between two lamps or functions, the shape of the periphery of the illuminating surface of the rear lamp shall be used.
requirements.quote: For other applications of the illuminating surface, e.g. distance between two lamps or functions, the shape of the periphery of this illuminating surface shall be used.

requirements.text: The screens used to determine the illuminating surface of the rear lamp shall remain parallel.
requirements.quote: The screens shall remain parallel, but other orientations are allowed to be used.

requirements.text: In the case where the S3 or S4 category stop lamp is installed inside the vehicle, the light emitted by the stop lamp shall not cause discomfort to the driver through the devices for indirect vision and/or other surfaces of the vehicle (i.e. rear window).
requirements.quote: In the case where it is installed inside the vehicle: The light emitted shall not cause discomfort to the driver through the devices for indirect vision and/or other surfaces of the vehicle (i.e. rear window).

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F, the markings shall be positioned on the outside at least once on strips in a 0.5 m distance.
requirements.quote: In case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F. These markings shall be positioned on the outside at least once: (a) on strips in a 0.5 m distance, (b) on areas within 100 mm x 100 mm.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F, the markings shall be positioned on the outside at least once on areas within 100 mm x 100 mm.
requirements.quote: In case of retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F. These markings shall be positioned on the outside at least once: (a) on strips in a 0.5 m distance, (b) on areas within 100 mm x 100 mm.

requirements.text: In length: at least one side retro-reflector shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side retro-reflector being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front.
requirements.quote: In length: at least one side retro-reflector shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side retro-reflector being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front.

requirements.text: The distance between two adjacent side retro-reflectors shall not exceed 3 m.
requirements.quote: The distance between two adjacent side retro-reflectors shall not exceed 3 m.

requirements.text: If the structure, design or the operational use of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply with such a requirement, this distance may be increased to 4 m.
requirements.quote: If the structure, design or the operational use of the vehicle makes it impossible to comply with such a requirement, this distance may be increased to 4 m.

requirements.text: The distance between the rearmost side retro-reflector and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m, except that for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length, except that for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.quote: The distance between the rearmost side retro-reflector and the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 1 m. However, for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length. However, for motor vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m, it is sufficient to have one side retro-reflector fitted within the first third and/or one within the last third of the vehicle length.

requirements.text: The measuring distance for the photometry of the retro-reflector shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
requirements.quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the parking lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 5, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for parking lamps directed to the rear incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 5. However, a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for parking lamps directed to the rear incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane;

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the side marker lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 9.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 9.

requirements.text: For the red side marker lamp, in the angular field from 60° to 90° in horizontal direction and ±20° in vertical direction towards the front of the vehicle, the maximum intensity shall be limited to 2.5∙10^-1 cd.
requirements.quote: In addition, for red side marker lamp, in the angular field from 60° to 90° in horizontal direction and ±20° in vertical direction towards the front of the vehicle, the maximum intensity is limited to 2.5∙10-1 cd.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: If the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided, the emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.

requirements.text: If the hazard warning signal is activated, the emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF.
requirements.quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.

requirements.text: When the reversing lamp is switched ON and both cornering lamps are so switched ON simultaneously, both cornering lamps shall be switched OFF when the reversing lamp is switched OFF.
requirements.quote: If so switched ON, both cornering lamps shall be switched OFF either: (a) When the reversing lamp is switched OFF; or (b) When the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h.

requirements.text: When the reversing lamp is switched ON and both cornering lamps are so switched ON simultaneously, both cornering lamps shall be switched OFF when the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h.
requirements.quote: If so switched ON, both cornering lamps shall be switched OFF either: (a) When the reversing lamp is switched OFF; or (b) When the forward speed of the vehicle exceeds 15 km/h.

requirements.text: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.quote: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps and their markings shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.

requirements.text: When tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation, the chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: For measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS), the limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).

requirements.text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear of the rear lamp shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be arranged as specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
requirements.quote: Arrangement As specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall have the orientation as specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.
requirements.quote: Orientation As specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.

requirements.text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2. shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6 or, in the case of the Advance Warning Triangle, the sample A shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 2. of Part 2 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2. shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6 or, in the case of the Advance Warning Triangle, the sample A shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 2. of Part 2 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors shall be considered as acceptable if the test has been passed, except that if the test on sample A is not complied with, the two retro-reflective devices of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflectors shall be considered as acceptable if the test has been passed. However, if the test on sample A is not complied with, the two retro-reflective devices of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure, and both shall pass the test.

requirements.text: If the test on sample A is not complied with, both retro-reflective devices of sample B shall pass the test.
requirements.quote: However, if the test on sample A is not complied with, the two retro-reflective devices of sample B shall be subjected to the same procedure, and both shall pass the test.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be positioned as specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.
requirements.quote: Position As specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.

requirements.text: The number of emergency stop signal lamps shall be as specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
requirements.quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.quote: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.

requirements.text: In the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: In the absorber chamber test, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.

requirements.text: If a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer fitted with a service braking system of either continuous or semi-continuous type, as defined in Regulation No.13, it shall be ensured that a constant power supply is provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.
requirements.quote: If a motor vehicle is equipped to tow a trailer fitted with a service braking system of either continuous or semi-continuous type, as defined in Regulation No.13, it shall be ensured that a constant power supply is provided via the electrical connector for the stop lamps to such trailers while the service brake is applied.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8 where the minimum luminous intensities shall be fulfilled:.
requirements.quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 8 where the minimum luminous intensities shall be fulfilled:

requirements.text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform.
requirements.quote: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.

requirements.text: When the uniformity of illuminance is checked with a measuring element whose sensitive area is not greater than one-tenth of the area to be examined, the variation in the value of the illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device shall comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05.
requirements.quote: The variation in the value of the illuminance shall then comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on all motor vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m.
requirements.quote: Mandatory: On all motor vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on all trailers.
requirements.quote: On all trailers.

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 for the levels in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19a.
requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9: - for the levels in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19a.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19b.
requirements.quote: - for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 19b.

requirements.text: For direction indicators of category 6, an indication "R" or "L" shall be shown on the lamp, indicating the right or left side of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For direction indicators of category 6 an indication "R" or "L" shall be shown on the lamp, indicating the right or left side of the vehicle.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, the coefficient of retro-reflection R' shall be measured in conformity with Part 2 of Annex 6, the sample unit being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of a sample unit of retro-reflective marking the coefficient of retro-reflection R' shall be measured in conformity with Part 2 of Annex 6, the sample unit being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: The reversing projector shall emit an intensity of light not exceeding 1.20∙10^4 cd within the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, when installed in any mounting position specified by the applicant.
requirements.quote: The intensity of light emitted shall not exceed 1.20∙104 cd within the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, when installed in any mounting position specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° to the front and to the rear.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° to the front and to the rear.

requirements.text: The side retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1 above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a or 2b may be varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6. or paragraph 5.6.11. of UN Regulation No. [LSD].
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of a direction indicator lamp of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a or 2b may be varied during a flash by sequential activation of light sources as specified in paragraph 5.6. of UN Regulation No. 6. or paragraph 5.6.11. of UN Regulation No. [LSD].

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5 shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angles: 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5. However: (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°;

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5 shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: (b) Where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps of category 6 shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 30° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.quote: 30° above and 5° below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of category 6.

requirements.text: For the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear, except that for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° to the front and to the rear; however for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. above and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2. above, the side-marker lamp shall have horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. above and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2. above, the angles are 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle (see the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2. above).

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, the field strength shall be a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, with ISO 11451-4 BCI method the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, with ISO 11451-4 BCI method the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, with ISO 11451-4 BCI method the current shall be a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, with ISO 11451-4 BCI method the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.text: During the calibration phase, extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place.
requirements.quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.

requirements.text: During calibration, no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point.
requirements.quote: No extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.

requirements.text: When measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA in candelas per m2 per lux (cd/m2/lux) of the retro-reflective areas of the retro-reflective marking material in new condition shall be at least as indicated in Table 6 for white, yellow and red materials.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA in candelas per m2 per lux (cd/m2/lux) of the retro-reflective areas in new condition shall be at least as indicated in Table 6 for white, yellow and red materials.

requirements.text: If the sample is provided with an orientation mark, the specified values of Table 6 shall only be observed for this orientation.
requirements.quote: Note: If the sample is provided with an orientation mark, the specified values must only be observed for this orientation.

requirements.text: Test samples without an orientation mark shall be observed for values of Table 6 at 0° and 90° orientations as well.
requirements.quote: Test samples without an orientation mark must be observed for values at 0° and 90° orientations as well.

requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The emission of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2:2011, as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 18.
requirements.quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2:2011, as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 18.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: It shall be accompanied by: 3.1.2.1. drawings, sufficiently detailed to permit identification of the type and, if applicable, of the category of the lamp, showing:.
requirements.quote: It shall be accompanied by: 3.1.2.1. drawings, sufficiently detailed to permit identification of the type and, if applicable, of the category of the lamp, showing:

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2, as described in Annex 10 with the test levels given in Table 20.
requirements.quote: Method of testing The immunity of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2, as described in Annex 10 with the test levels given in Table 20.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 3 of Annex 4 for stability of photometric properties.
requirements.quote: Stability of photometric properties A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6 for resistance to penetration of water.
requirements.quote: Resistance to penetration of water A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 4 of Annex 6 for resistance to corrosion.
requirements.quote: Resistance to corrosion A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 4 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 8 for resistance to cleaning.
requirements.quote: Resistance to cleaning A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 8.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 7 for resistance to fuels.
requirements.quote: Resistance to fuels A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 7.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 6 for resistance to heat.
requirements.quote: Resistance to heat A specimen of the sample unit shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 1 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: A specimen of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 6 of Annex 6 for resistance to weathering.
requirements.quote: Resistance to weathering A specimen shall be subjected to a test as specified in Part 6 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The rear lamp approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.
requirements.quote: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5. and 6. above.

requirements.text: To verify compliance of the rear lamp with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: The minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 shall be complied with;

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON.

requirements.text: This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
requirements.quote: The measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree;

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.quote: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7. below, and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
requirements.quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable;

requirements.text: When the electrical connections are checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle, the lamps shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

requirements.text: When the electrical connections are checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle, the tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In the heat resistance test, the lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.
requirements.quote: The lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.

requirements.text: In the heat resistance test, the ambient temperature shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: The ambient temperature shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: In the heat resistance test, the light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for the lamp, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for the lamp and shall be supplied with a current at a voltage such that it gives the specified average power at the corresponding test voltage. However, for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the heat resistance test, the light source shall be supplied with a current at a voltage such that it gives the specified average power at the corresponding test voltage, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The light source used shall be a light source of the category specified for the lamp and shall be supplied with a current at a voltage such that it gives the specified average power at the corresponding test voltage. However, for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the resistance to water test, a section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours and then left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions.
requirements.quote: A section of a sample unit not less than 300 mm long shall be immersed in distilled water at a temperature of 23 ± 5ºC for a period of 18 hours; it shall then be left to dry for 24 hours under normal laboratory conditions.

requirements.text: After completion of the resistance to water test, the section shall be examined.
requirements.quote: After completion of the test, the section shall be examined.

requirements.text: After completion of the resistance to water test, no part of the retro-reflective marking plate section inside 10 mm from the cut edge shall show evidence of deterioration which would reduce the effectiveness of the plate.
requirements.quote: No part inside 10 mm from the cut edge shall show evidence of deterioration which would reduce the effectiveness of the plate.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.

requirements.text: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.2. of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.2. of Annex 6.

requirements.text: In the case of headlamps fitted with measures to prevent discomfort to other road-users in a country where traffic operates on the side of the road opposite to that of the country for which the headlamp was designed, such measures shall be achieved automatically or by the vehicle user with the vehicle in the park condition without the need for special tools (other than those provided with the vehicle).
requirements.quote: In the case of headlamps fitted with measures to prevent discomfort to other road-users in a country where traffic operates on the side of the road opposite to that of the country for which the headlamp was designed, such measures shall be achieved automatically or by the vehicle user with the vehicle in the park condition without the need for special tools (other than those provided with the vehicle6).

requirements.text: In the case of headlamps fitted with measures to prevent discomfort to other road-users in a country where traffic operates on the side of the road opposite to that of the country for which the headlamp was designed, detailed instructions shall be provided by the vehicle manufacturer with the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Detailed instructions shall be provided by the vehicle manufacturer with the vehicle.

requirements.quote: All the definitions given in the latest series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 48 in force at the time of application for type approval shall apply, unless otherwise specified in this UN Regulation or in the pertinent installation UN Regulations Nos. 53, 74 and 86.

requirements.text: The light sources shall be a light source which can only be replaced by replacement of the light source module to which this light source is fixed; (in case of a light source module).
requirements.quote: In case of a light source module: a light source which can only be replaced by replacement of the light source module to which this light source is fixed;

requirements.text: The light sources shall be a light source which can only be replaced by replacement of the lighting unit to which this light source is fixed. (in case of afs).
requirements.quote: In case of AFS: a light source which can only be replaced by replacement of the lighting unit to which this light source is fixed.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 12, the limits for rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection are those defined in IEC 61000-3-11, Clause 5: - The value of Pst shall not be greater than 1.0; - The value of Plt shall not be greater than 0.65; - The value of d(t) during a voltage change shall not exceed 3.3 per cent for more than 500 ms; - The relative steady-state voltage change, dc, shall not exceed 3.3 per cent; - The maximum relative voltage change dmax, shall not exceed 6 per cent.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 12, the limits for rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection are those defined in IEC 61000-3-11, Clause 5: - The value of Pst shall not be greater than 1.0; - The value of Plt shall not be greater than 0.65; - The value of d(t) during a voltage change shall not exceed 3.3 per cent for more than 500 ms; - The relative steady-state voltage change, dc, shall not exceed 3.3 per cent; - The maximum relative voltage change dmax, shall not exceed 6 per cent.
